import fastapi
import starlette.applications
from fastapi import FastAPI as Api
from starlette.applications import Starlette as Web

def api(service: object) -> object:
    application = fastapi.FastAPI()
    application.state.service = service
    return application.state.service

def web(service: object) -> object:
    application = starlette.applications.Starlette()
    application.state.service = service
    return application.state.service

def aliased_api(service: object) -> object:
    application = Api()
    application.state.service = service
    return application.state.service

def aliased_web(service: object) -> object:
    application = Web()
    application.state.service = service
    return application.state.service
